facts.text: Conrad Pune is in the Central Business District in Koregaon, Pune.
facts.excerpt: Conrad Pune, a luxurious hotel located in the heart of the Central Business District in Koregaon, Pune

facts.text: The airport is 7 kilometres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: **Airport** 7 kilometres away

facts.text: The railway station is 3 kilometres from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: **Railway Station** 3 kilometres away

facts.text: Each room is decorated with art pieces and collectives.
facts.excerpt: Each room is decorated with mesmerising art pieces and collectives

facts.text: The Deluxe Room - King has city views through floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: spectacular city views through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: The Deluxe Room - King has an in-room espresso machine.
facts.excerpt: high-speed internet, and an in-room espresso machine

facts.excerpt: Pune’s first outdoor temperature-controlled swimming pool, with an in-built whirlpool

facts.text: The pool extends to the Kabana, a western lounge.
facts.excerpt: The pool extends to the Kabana, the western lounge.

facts.text: The hotel has a kids' pool.
facts.excerpt: Conrad Pune also houses a kid’s pool.

facts.text: The Conrad Spa has four treatment rooms and a couple's room.
facts.excerpt: Four treatment rooms and a couple’s room host signature massages, therapies, facials, and baths

facts.text: Spa treatments range from Ayurvedic treatments to Western therapies.
facts.excerpt: from deep-rooted ayurvedic treatments to therapies infused with the dynamics of western means of healing

facts.text: Each wellbeing changing room has a sauna and a steam room.
facts.excerpt: Each changing room comes with a Sauna and Steam room

facts.excerpt: Professional hair stylists and beauty therapists at the Conrad Salon

facts.text: The fitness facility is open around the clock.

facts.text: Use of the wellbeing facilities is for hotel resident guests only.

facts.text: Al Di La is an outdoor rooftop bar 72 metres above ground level with views of Pune.
facts.excerpt: Revel in the luxury of an outdoor rooftop bar at 72 meters above ground level at a 5 star hotel in Pune. With its hypnotizing and enthralling view of Pune city

facts.text: Al Di La serves Italian dishes, including pasta and tiramisu.
facts.excerpt: Al Di La is known for its sumptuous Italian delicacies, including pasta, tiramisu, and more.

facts.text: Coriander Kitchen has alfresco seating overlooking a waterscape.
facts.excerpt: alfresco seating overlooking a serene waterscape

facts.text: Koji serves the flavours of Japan, China and Thailand.

facts.text: Pune Sugar Box is a tea room serving coffee, teas and desserts.
facts.excerpt: A classic tea-room setting with a gorgeous and sprightly interior, Pune Sugar Box, one of the Conrad restaurants, brings to you global blends of finely-brewed coffee

facts.excerpt: Discover the true essence of indulgence and elegance at Conrad Pune, luxury crafted by Hilton.
